verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform with an admin dashboard, so in-product AI insights from store data is a fair axis. The evidence shows no such feature. The MCP server only searches Medusa documentation, and the Cloud Development Agent and agent guardrails help with building customizations, not with analysing merchant data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
